text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "One day, having gotten through the busy period, I finally had a little breathing room."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Let's go on a hot springs trip.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Machan realized.
If it's no good for three people to use it,
and I can't go with Vodka and the others—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That the two of us, just you and me, Trainer, should go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And with that, we're heading out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, quickly packing our bags,
...we were off to a hot spring trip.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's so much more spacious
than it looked in the photos.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, passing through there promotes good health.
Let us step through with great spirit.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, test, test.
Good morning, good evening.
Right now, I'm on a hot spring trip with Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The chairs are fluffy, and the tea is piping hot.
As expected of a hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, this cafe supposedly has local specialties on a secret menu, so I intend to order them.
—That is all. End of recording.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
C-Can we really stay here?
It's so big and shiny...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The lottery is not to be underestimated...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew.
Hot springs are not to be underestimated either.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After running all over the place with her guiding the way,
before I knew it, the sun had completely set.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Night has completely fallen. It went by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Going to sightseeing spots, visiting cafes while strolling through town,
and relaxing in the hot springs at the inn.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...We made so many memories.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"There is still time before the meal.
Let us go for a short walk."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It seems there's a good spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The place I was led to like that was—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Siiigh............
You're right, there's no one here.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The stars are sparkling too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan stayed silent for a while, gazing up at the night sky,
and then, out of nowhere—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Would you like to know Mar-chan's secret?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret.
A shocking truth, really.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...As for Machan, you see.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Mar-chan actually knows
that Mar-chan is a little strange, you know."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to become a mascot.
Being afraid of being forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Other girls don't say it much.
It's not something people really understand.
That's why I knew.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that is precisely why.
...You are one of a kind."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: That day. That day at the beach.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Defying the obvious,
you told me that you needed me there too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Defying the obvious,
you told me that you needed me there too.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"One must walk through life alone.
That is what I believed. And I still do today."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, I really didn't think there'd be someone
who would actually say something like that.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ......That made me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so happy, it's still soaking deep into my heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wind blew across the high ground.
Aston Machan murmured softly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...May we continue from here on out?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: This is my selfish wish. My very special one.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The length, the speed, and the depth are all different.
On top of that, it's a road that will eventually lead to the sea.
Even so, regardless—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Will you continue to flow alongside me
for as long as possible?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm glad that you're strange.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable
bond between Aston Machan
and myself...
